statement.excerpt: At this point, there is no turning back. Governments going forward will have to consider which deployments are unsafe, and block those that are.

from_speaker: will have to consider which deployments are unsafe
our_interpretation: Read as a forecast that government safety review and blocking of deployments judged unsafe will become an established practice, especially in the United States and other governments.
Governments does not mean that every government must act identically.
The surrounding policy recommendations create a normative ambiguity, but the firm language permits an ordinary empirical reading.
No turning back is part of the prediction, not a separately triggered antecedent.
Going forward supplies no deadline. A finite observation cannot establish literal permanent irreversibility.
criteria.support_condition: Post-publication records show established government review of AI deployment safety and implemented blocking of deployments judged unsafe, beyond the single intervention discussed in the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Government records establish abandonment of the claimed review-and-blocking practice across the relevant jurisdictions. A lack of a new block during a short period does not contradict the forecast.
